fields.title: Cracking Your Dream Job Interview
fields.description: Join this interactive session with a Senior Software Engineer from Google who will share insider tips on how to ace technical and behavioral interviews at top tech companies. Learn how to prepare your portfolio, handle coding challenges, and negotiate your offer.

fields.title: From Student to Tech Leader
fields.description: Discover the journey from being a computer science student in Africa to becoming a CTO at a successful tech startup. This session covers leadership skills, startup culture, and how to position yourself for senior roles early in your career.

fields.title: Breaking into AI & Machine Learning
fields.description: An ML Engineer from Meta walks you through the roadmap to becoming an AI professional. Topics include self-learning resources, building projects, contributing to open source, and landing your first AI role — all with an African context in mind.

fields.title: Studying in Indonesia: A Complete Guide
fields.description: Everything you need to know about moving to Indonesia for your studies. From visa requirements and scholarship applications to finding accommodation in Malang and adapting to Indonesian culture. Real experience shared by DDS alumni.

fields.title: Building Your First AI Product with FastAPI
fields.description: A hands-on technical workshop covering how to build and deploy an AI-powered REST API using FastAPI and Claude API. Participants built a working chatbot by the end of the session.
